svg.title: Hoeywea Troop Carrier - interpreted silhouette
svg.desc: Traders and Gunboats (2024), printed 10-11, PDF 11-12. Single-deck external envelope retains rounded cockpit pod, broad parallel troop body and flared rear aerofoils with chamfered corners. Illustration corroborates boxy carrier with short forward pod and rear fins. Fine guns and detached turret key excluded; troop seating borders not used.
